intro.heading: Intimate scenes need the same level of preparation, professionalism and care as any other specialist performance.
intro.paragraph1: At Take 3, we represent performers who are specifically trained to work within intimacy-led productions. They understand professional set etiquette, consent-based practices and the expectations of working alongside an Intimacy Coordinator: meaning your performers arrive prepared, professional and ready to work.
intro.paragraph2: From a tender moment between two characters to a fully choreographed intimate sequence, we can help you find the right performers for the scene.

trained.subheading: Professional performers. Clear expectations. A smoother set.
trained.paragraph: Many of our intimacy artists have had dedicated training in working professionally within intimate scenes and on-set environments. We have hosted specific intimacy workshops led by industry-renowned coordinators, exploring practical approaches to:

items.name:
Lou
Kempton
items.quote: When I know talent is sourced from Take 3 Agency, I approach intimate scenes with confidence.
items.full:
As an Intimacy Coordinator, the quality and professionalism of supporting artists is integral to the safe and successful execution of intimate content on set. Take 3 Agency consistently delivers talented, professional, and engaging performers who make that work possible.

What sets Take 3 Agency apart is the balance their artists bring to every job — they take on choreography and direction with care and attentiveness while also contributing their own artistic ideas with integrity and skill. This creative collaboration elevates the work and makes for a richer on-set experience for everyone involved.

Whether working in deep background or interacting directly with lead and featured cast, Take 3 supporting artists foster a professional yet creative atmosphere that I genuinely value. When I know talent is sourced from Take 3 Agency, I approach intimate scenes with confidence.

I wholeheartedly recommend Tyler and his team to any production seeking outstanding results.
